name: Browser Meeting Bot Provider
description: A meeting-participant provider that joins Google Meet and Microsoft Teams through a browser in a container, posts a notice, publishes the call's audio into a LiveKit room, and leaves on any participant's stop command.
features: Joins Google Meet as a signed-in Workspace identity from a pool, or Microsoft Teams as a named guest
Posts the notice and confirms it before any audio is captured
Publishes the call's audio into a LiveKit room over rtc-node
Any participant's stop phrase makes the bot leave and purges the run
A scheduler per worker: one container per run, leases, a command channel, reconciliation
A fixture page and a lifecycle test that runs in CI
